notes: Frozen original geometry plus identical current observation and firing-state rules in both variants; no manual shots. Sequential fresh processes, order alternated by trial. Summary median/p95 are medians of the corresponding per-process statistic; maximum is the largest observed step across all trials. Init times use different loading pipelines and are not compared as summary-build cost. State JSON compared byte-for-byte, including observer records, team contacts and query/cache counts. CPU steps, not FPS. Trajectory generation excluded. Fixture is shared with the ordinary benchmark.
